data.name: Izzan
data.gender_notes: Izzan is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'izz', meaning 'power, might, and honor'. In Islamic tradition, Izzan is a name that represents the idea of being bestowed with divine grace and blessings. The name Izzan carries the meaning “Gift, Grace, Honor” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Izzan usually hope their child will grow to embody gift, grace, honor and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A reflection of Allah's strength and wisdom in the person
data.etymology: Izzan belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gift, Grace, Honor.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Izzan total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: عزان
in_arabic.meaning: يعني اسم عزان القوة و العزّة و الرفعة في الإسلام
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم عزان مشتق من الجذر العربي 'عز' الذي يعني القوة و العزّة. و هو اسم يدل على الرفعة و الشرف في الإسلام. و قد ورد في القرآن الكريم ذكر العزة لله تعالى في سورة الحج آية 40: 'ولله العزة ولرسوله وللمؤمنين'.

in_urdu.name: عزان
in_urdu.meaning: عزان نام کا مطلب ہے طاقت، عزت اور علو در اسلام
in_urdu.long_meaning: عزان نام عربی جڑ 'عز' سے ماخوذ ہے جس کا مطلب ہے طاقت اور عزت۔ یہ نام اسلام میں رفعت اور شرافت کی علامت ہے۔ قرآن کریم میں الحج سورة کی آیت 40 میں 'ولله العزة ولرسوله وللمؤمنين' کے طور پر اللہ تعالیٰ کی عزت کا ذکر آیا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: इज़्ज़ान
in_hindi.meaning: इज़्ज़ान नाम का अर्थ है ताकत, इज़्ज़त और उंचाई इस्लाम में
in_hindi.long_meaning: इज़्ज़ान नाम अरबी मूल 'عز' से लिया गया है जिसका अर्थ है शक्ति और सम्मान। यह नाम इस्लाम में ऊंचाई और प्रतिष्ठा का प्रतीक है। कुरआन में अल-हज सूरत की आयत 40 में 'ولله العزة ولرسوله وللمؤمنين' के रूप में अल्लाह की इज़्ज़त का उल्लेख है।

in_pashto.name: عزان
in_pashto.meaning: عزان نوم معنی یې دی قوت، عزت او لوړوالی په اسلام کې
in_pashto.long_meaning: عزان نوم د عربی جذر 'عز' څخه اخیستل شوی دی چې معنی یې ده قوت او عزت. دا نوم په اسلام کې د لوړوالی او شرافت نښه ده. په قرآن کریم کې د الحج سورت په آیت 40 کې 'ولله العزة ولرسوله وللمؤمنين' د الله تعالی عزت یادونه شوې ده.

in_english.name: Izzan
in_english.meaning: Izzan means power, strength, and elevation in Islamic context
in_english.long_meaning: The name Izzan is derived from the Arabic root 'عز' (ʿ-z-z), which signifies power, strength, and might. In Islamic tradition, the name Izzan embodies the concept of elevation and honor. The Quran references God's glory and might in various verses, such as Surah Al-Hajj, verse 40: 'And to Allah belongs the glory, and to His Messenger, and to the believers.' The name Izzan is chosen for its positive connotations of resilience, dignity, and spiritual strength.

data.cultural_impact: The name Izzan signifies strength, power, and dignity, reflecting the values of Islamic culture, both in personal and collective contexts. It is believed that those who bear this name possess these qualities and are revered within their communities.
data.spiritual_significance: According to Islamic beliefs, the name Izzan holds deep spiritual significance as it relates to the concept of receiving God's Divine Favors and Blessings. It embodies the idea of being chosen, loved, and protected by Allah, offering a reminder of the importance of living a pious and obedient life.
